text: With their chief driven off, the raiders scatter. By the well, the boy still has both hands wound in his mother's sleeve.
Kai kneels. He finds Essa's cloth bundle under his coat and works the knot loose. The bread is a little crushed. It still smells of her kitchen.
He breaks off a piece and holds it out. The boy looks to his mother before taking it.

speaker: Mother
text: You'll need that for the road.

speaker: Kai
text: Ma packed too much. She usually does.
The boy takes a bite. His grip on his mother's sleeve loosens enough for her to shift her leg.
Perrin offers his cloak. The boy shrinks from the sudden movement; Perrin stops, then lays it within the mother's reach.

speaker: Perrin
text: For both of you. If you want it.

speaker: Mother
text: Could you hold this a moment?
Serra kneels to steady the binding on the woman's leg. Rina sets a waterskin beside the bread.

speaker: Kai
text: Not now. I don't know what it is.
A beat. Then Perrin laughs, quietly this time. Kai saves the heel of the loaf and wraps it again.

speaker: Serra
text: We're going to Vael too. Walk with us when you're ready.
Serra. Rina. Perrin. Just names, for now. Kai tucks the bundle away and waits until the boy has finished eating.
